svg.title: Creating a ticket: layers and flow
svg.desc: Layered architecture. Runtime: Screen, useTickets hook, Redux store, bootstrap, createTicket use case, HttpTicketGateway adapter, Backend API. Presentation never calls the use case directly: it goes through bootstrap. The adapter is connected to the use case by dependency injection, not by bootstrap. TicketGateway is a source-code contract only.
svg.text: A request travels down through the layers. Follow the numbers.
